title: Instrument meal plan conversion and detail loading
description: Add the requested logs to shopping-list creation from meal plans and meal-plan detail loading, including per-recipe load/skip visibility where parse failures are currently swallowed.
acceptance_criteria: `CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService.create` logs entry with plan URL and target list name and logs exit with resulting URL or error.
Per-recipe load/skip behavior inside `CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService` is logged so swallowed parse failures are observable.
`MealPlanDetailView.loadPlan` logs entry with plan URL and exit with block count and total recipe count.

handoff_summary.completed: All three acceptance criteria met: (1) create() logs entry with planURL and name, and exits with URL on success or warning on each of three error paths; (2) per-recipe load/skip behavior is now observable via debug (loaded) and warning (skip) logs; (3) loadPlan() logs entry with plan filename and exit with block count and resolved recipe count.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Changes are additive log-only; no logic was altered.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for verification of log output correctness and format consistency with sibling beads.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — both files are self-contained within this bead's scope; no overlap with sibling beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Kept skip warning message consistent with project pattern ([ClassName] method: verb noun). Updated the pre-existing skip warning from a slightly different format to match the new `create:` prefix for consistency. The listAlreadyExists path also gets a warning exit log since it is an early-return error the caller must handle.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests run per developer guardrails. Tester agent should verify log lines appear under the mealPlans category with correct privacy labels.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: loadPlan exit log reflects resolvedRecipes.count (unique recipe paths) rather than total duplicate-inclusive references — this is the most operationally useful count for diagnosing load behavior.

conflict_risks: None — both files are self-contained within this bead's scope; no overlap with sibling beads.

execution_history.summary: Added OSLog instrumentation to CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService.create (entry, per-recipe load/skip, and all exit paths) and MealPlanDetailView.loadPlan (entry and exit with block/recipe counts). Added missing `import os` to MealPlanDetailView.swift.
